$comment: Images still referenced by tag only (scripts/supply_chain.py check, rule IMAGE-PIN; SEC-SC-11). C6.44, by category: a build base (FROM) and every image a test, CI or contributor stack runs is pinned as tag@sha256:<index digest>, the tag kept for people and for Dependabot's docker and docker-compose updates, which move the digest; a store in the files install.sh runs (`userRunFiles`) stays at its exact version tag (category user-run-service), because the air-gapped install loads or tags images by name and a digest reference matches only an image pulled from a registry; an image PipesHub builds itself (first-party) stays by tag until the release pipeline signs it and the signed digest is pinned (the owner part of C6.44). A new tag-only reference fails the check; so does an entry that is pinned or gone, a third-party entry of any other category, or a user-run-service entry used outside `userRunFiles`. localDigest is the index digest of the tag on the build host when it was present (docker image inspect), not a pull; regenerate with `python3 scripts/supply_chain.py images`.

tagOnly.note: A store install.sh runs: kept at its exact version tag so an air-gapped host can `docker load` or `docker tag` it (a digest reference matches only a pulled image), and so the installed tag takes the publisher's rebuilds for OS fixes.
